node.statement: Constant alignment: take C_ch,kappa_ch from lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control; take C_pol to be the maximum of the polar coefficients in lem-stage1-polar-retraction and lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws and kappa_pol the minimum of their margins; and take C_grp from lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws. Enlarging a coefficient and decreasing a margin only strengthens every hypothesis needed to invoke those lemmas. It remains to choose universal C_der large and kappa_der in (0,1/2] small after the universal constants in the estimates below are fixed.
